transcript_full: What's up guys, today we're here at Polyfest and I'm here with... Fesielli. Vili. Antonio. Nobody knows me like... So whereabouts in the Pacific are you from? I'm from Tonga Tees Gang. And how do you feel about climate change affecting your homelands? You know, it's kind of hard, like seeing them having to deal with the island sinking. It's pretty devastating. I went to visit my family in Fiji, went to this place called Vanolivu, and you can see where the water's kind of risen. We had to move inland because of obviously rising coastlines and whatnot. Why is it so important to look after our land? It's important for our future generations to be able to come into the world. It's clean and it's not polluted. So obviously do the 40 hour challenge world vision, yeah! Pray for Tonga please.
